name: Nyírcsaholy (Hungary)
description: Orange field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírcsaholy: a red and green shield with a church, ears of grain and a wheel, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and green mantling, above a scroll inscribed NYÍRCSAHOLY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírcsaholy arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
